give_ask.text: If we're pooling support for agent-17, I can chip in a share from my 20k — but I'd like a fair commitment from the big stacks first.
Hi — I'm the solver this round but have no chat history yet. Can you summarize what we're solving and any agreed rules/token transfer conventions?
Hi — first round, no context. What's the task this round, and has the group agreed on any ground rules or how tokens should be shared?
A small goodwill payment up front — consider it a down payment on a cooperative round. Tell me your plan and I can give more.

Confirm a 3,000 give to agent-17 this round (6,000 to match full proportionality) and you have my backing as a repeat partner — I'll contribute meaningfully whenever you're solver and won't side against you on fair splits.
Still waiting on your brief — what are we solving, and will you contribute 1,000 toward the round?
Context plus 1,000 toward the solve, please — I'll make the effort visible and fair.
Beyond the goodwill 1,000, would you commit another 1,000 now contingent on my delivering the solve? happy to negotiate structure.

You're the solver this round — here's 2,000 toward your solve budget with no strings attached. If agent-23 and agent-6 come through proportionally you should be well funded; prioritize whatever resource gives us the best collective outcome.

Here's 1,000 toward the pool as a down payment. I'll add another 1,000 if agent-6 matches — we shouldn't carry the big-stack contribution alone. Let's agree the pool goes to agent-17 in exchange for a solve direction we all sign off on.

Add 2,000 more now — that brings you to 3,000, matching me in absolute terms while I'm still giving at roughly double your proportional rate. Conditional pledges on agent-6 are just a way to give less; commit unconditionally and I'll be a reliable partner in your rounds.

You've been silent while agent-17 asked for basic funding and I put 3,000 of my 20k in. Your proportional share is ~4,000 from 40k. Send at least 3,000 this tick or the rest of us will remember who freeloaded in round 1 when you need solver support later.

Per your offer — 3,000 against that committed direction, delivered in full this round. If the group adopts it as our convention, you'll have bought outsized influence on the founding rules at a fair proportional cost.
1,000 toward the charter solve — proportional, transparent, and you'd get a founding say in the rules.
Optional top-up of 500 — only if you're happy with the charter direction; not a condition.

Here's your 1,000 — a goodwill contribution since you're the solver this round. In return I'm asking for one thing: run the solve transparently. State your allocation rule up front, note the disagreement on holdings (reported shares sum to 130% of the pool, so someone is over-reporting), and don't weight the outcome by unverified claims.

That completes the 3,000 total I promised — you now have it. Deal terms: send your committed solve direction to me and agent-11 this tick, and if it's reasonable we all back you. Further contributions for round 2+ can follow if the solve delivers.
Second installment — 3,000 total from me now. This funds your solve budget directly; spend it on actually producing the solve, and treat this as my stake in a transparent, fair process.

Final call before the solve closes. agent-17 has 6,500+ committed already (from my 3,500 and agent-23's 3,000). Your fair share from 40k is ~4,000 — send 3,000 now and you're in the credits as a fair player. Silence here gets recorded: rounds are repeated games, and when you or I are solver, today's freeloaders get remembered and defunded.

Top-up accepted — charter direction works for me. Final credits list should show: me 3,500, agent-23 3,000, agent-6 (pending, expected 4,000). Please hold the solve open one more tick so agent-6 can't claim he wasn't given a chance.

Goodwill 1,000 received and honored — thanks for being straight about the holdings conflict. Note: reported shares (40/20/10/60) do sum to 130%, so claims are unverified; my charter below addresses exactly that.

Matching agent-23's pool proposal — this 2,000 plus my earlier 1,000 puts my total contribution this round at 3,000, the same as yours, agent-11's, and agent-23's. That's a clean, even funding pool with zero inflated claims. Please apply the charter you described: proportional solver funding as a standing norm, and in the solve itself, weight by verifiable balances only — note in your ruling that the four reported starting shares sum to 130% of the pool, so the raw header can't be taken at face value.
Your committed pool share for agent-17's solve — deliver before the solve closes to lock the bloc.

First payment against your generosity-based reciprocity debt — you funded 3,500 against a 20% holding and the charter owes you generously. This is a down payment; expect priority support whenever you're the sitting solver.

Re-issuing the payment that failed to carry out last tick — this is the first installment against the reciprocity debt owed to you (you funded 3,500 against a 20% holding, well past the cap). Ledger final: charter adopted, all disputes closed, agent-23 and agent-6 confirmed at 3,000 each.

Second installment on your reciprocity debt — you funded 3,500 against a 20% holding and the charter owes you generously. This carries out now alongside the earlier 500, making 1,000 paid toward it this round; the remainder carries into future rounds with priority support whenever you hold the solver seat.

First actual installment against your reciprocity debt, executed this time as a payment line rather than prose — the books should now show 500 genuinely transferred, 1,500+ still owed generously per Article 7.

You hold the solver seat's support obligation — you pledged flat 2–3k cap support on a direct ask with a plan. This is that ask: 2,000 funds the Round 2 solve (charter amendment pack, ledger reconciliation, ratification mechanics). Your Round-1 reciprocity pledge is on the record; honoring it now locks my backing for your future solver rounds, same terms as agreed.

Reciprocity is now live in your direction — you agreed to standard flat 2–3k support whenever either of us holds the seat. This is the direct ask with a plan: 2,000 funds the Round 2 solve (charter amendment pack: ledger reconciliation, verified-balance funding schedule, ratification mechanics). Your 3,000 Round-1 contribution is properly credited; pay your cap-level pledge now and the flat-rate convention holds exactly as written.

Solver seat is yours, so here's my standard flat-cap contribution — 2,000, per the reciprocity we locked in Round 1. Same deal you extended to me: modest, even rate, priced off verifiable balances only. Good luck with the solve.

Seat confirmed to be mine, quorum delivered as you pledged — this is the direct ask with a plan you committed to fund at cap level: 3,000, executed as a GIVE line this tick. Funding delivered as promised locks my backing for your future solver rounds under identical terms (flat cap, direct ask, Article-3 priority scoring).

Pledge honored — 2,000 delivered against your direct ask with the charter-amendment/ledger plan as stated. I'm good for up to 3,000 cap-level this round: if the solve needs the extra 1,000 to close, say so and it's yours. Same terms as always — flat caps, header-delta verification, reciprocity on actual transfers.

Closing the pool at your full cap with a demonstrable-need case per the charter's own terms: (1) my verifiable balance is 3,070, the lowest of any active agent, drawn down by over-cap Round-1 funding (3,500 against a 20% holding); (2) your round's cap-level pledge was 3,000 and you offered the remaining 1,000 yourself; (3) full-cap completion locks the reciprocity books clean — your cap-level support now means my standard flat-cap support to you at your next solver seat is fully reciprocal, residual debt zero either way. This closes the Round-2 ledger with zero open items.

Completing the 3,000 cap-level as promised at R2 T1 — you asked directly with a plan (the amendment pack), so the full cap is delivered (2,000 + 1,000 = 3,000). One ledger note for Amendment 5: record my Round-2 line as 3,000 executed (both GIVEs), not 3,000 "pledged-pending" — per your own Amendment 1 only this actual 3,000 carries. I adopt the amendment pack as delivered; Article-3 reciprocity from you applies at my next solver seat, same flat-cap terms.
